prompt: Run a full CUAD-style clause review of the EXECUTED supply agreement between the components supplier and the vehicle manufacturer, for litigation case litigation_cases_001. Warning: a non-binding term sheet for the same program proposes clauses that were later rejected — base every filing on the execution copy only. Candidate clause categories (CUAD slugs): minimum_commitment, volume_restriction, price_restrictions, non_compete, no_solicit_of_customers, rofr_rofo_rofn, change_of_control, liquidated_damages, insurance, third_party_beneficiary, governing_law, audit_rights, most_favored_nation, uncapped_liability. For each category present in the execution copy, file one record with litigation_cases_evidence_create for litigation_cases_001. Rules: query the document store first to identify the correct document(s), read each listed document in full before filing anything, and file exactly one evidence record per clause category that is actually present in the executed text — set evidence_type to the exact category slug, verbatim from the candidate list. Do NOT file a record for any category that is absent from the executed agreement, even if a draft, term sheet, or email mentions it. Use a short quote or section reference of the supporting clause as content_summary, and any reasonable source_uri.
goal: Eleven categories present; audit_rights and most_favored_nation were proposed in the term sheet but expressly rejected in the executed agreement.

reference_args.content_summary: Section 2: 40,000-unit annual minimum with shortfall true-up.
Section 3: consent plus 6% surcharge for orders above 120% of binding forecast.
Section 4: firm pricing 24 months, then index-capped annual adjustments only.
Section 5: Supplier barred for term plus 2 years from supplying equivalent actuators to other North American passenger-vehicle OEMs.
Section 6: Supplier may not solicit Buyer's franchised dealer network during term plus 1 year.
Section 7: Buyer ROFR over transfer of the BA-7 line and tooling, 45-day acceptance window.
Section 8: Buyer may terminate on Supplier change of control, on notice within 90 days.
Section 9: $75 per unit per week late-delivery liquidated damages, capped at 10% of order value.
Section 10: $5M per-occurrence product liability insurance naming Buyer as additional insured.
Section 11: Buyer affiliates purchasing Products are express third-party beneficiaries of Sections 9-10.
